summary: Olin Corp filed an 8-K announcing a merger agreement to combine with Huntsman Corporation in an all-stock merger of equals. The transaction value is implied by exchange ratio—no explicit price per share stated. Both boards unanimously approved; no premium or break fee disclosed. Structure allows either a direct merger or two-step subsidiary mergers, with Olin surviving. The deal requires Olin shareholder approval by more than two-thirds of outstanding shares. Watch for regulatory clearance and shareholder votes; risk-arb focuses on stock price convergence and potential antitrust hurdles in chemicals sector.
